run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T15:08:46Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate warning is a downstream symptom of a bad configuration rolled out to the shipping Deployment at 2026-11-16T15:07:26Z. The new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 carries QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" instead of the previous "http://quote:8080"; shipping then fails to build a valid URI for its outbound quote POST (span "POST " with otel.status_description Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))), its /get-quote returns 500, checkout's PlaceOrder fails with gRPC 13, and frontend's POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500. Frontend error spans are confined to the checkout path (401.33 error-span increase in the 14m ending 15:18:46) and were zero in the comparable 14m windows ending 14:43:46 through 15:04:46, which matches the 15:07:26 rollout and the alert start 15:08:46. The error text relayed by checkout names the "email service", but the failing span is a URI-format error raised before any request is sent and no email error signal was observed; that alternative remains unconfirmed rather than the cause.

claims.text: Frontend error spans are limited to the checkout path: in the 14m window ending 2026-11-16T15:18:46, increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}) is 401.33 for span_name "POST /api/checkout", 401.33 for "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and 401.33 for the client span "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder", while every other frontend span_name shows 0 error spans in the same window.

The frontend checkout error is a new condition, not a baseline: the 14m increases for frontend "POST /api/checkout" / "POST" / "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" / "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" error spans are 0 at window ends 14:43:46, 14:50:46, 14:57:46 and 15:04:46, then 126.75 at 15:11:46 and 401.33 at 15:18:46.

Error-status spans in the 14m window ending 15:18:46 also exist on checkout (span_name "HTTP POST" and "oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder", 388.20 each) and on shipping (span_name "/get-quote" and "POST ", 389.25 each), and frontend-proxy recorded 411.70 error spans on "ingress" and 402.37 on "router frontend egress" versus 8.48/0.00 and 11.41/0.00 in the two earlier 14m windows.

Shipping's own errors are confined to two spans: in the 14m window ending 15:18:46, increase of error spans is 389.25 for span_name "/get-quote" and 389.25 for span_name "POST ", while "/get-quote" UNSET is 87.11, "/ship-order" UNSET 87.11 and "POST quote" UNSET 87.11.

Whole trace 3767891927621b4297f49efad5961ac3 shows the failing chain: load-generator POST (error, http.status_code 500) -> frontend-proxy "ingress" (error, 500) -> frontend "POST /api/checkout" (error, 500) -> frontend client span "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" (error, rpc.grpc.status_code 13, message "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500") -> checkout "oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" (error, rpc.grpc.status_code 13, same message) -> checkout "HTTP POST" (error) -> shipping "/get-quote" (error, otel.status_description "Internal Server Error") -> shipping child span "POST " (error, otel.status_description "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))"). Cart, currency and product-catalog spans in the same trace carry rpc.grpc.status_code "0".

The shipping Deployment's pod template sets env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" (plus SHIPPING_PORT=8080, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping), and the Deployment status shows observedGeneration 2 with replicas 1/ready 1.

Two shipping ReplicaSets exist, both owned by Deployment shipping and both using image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping: shipping-75d58f5d84 (created 2026-11-16T14:30:55Z, replicas 0) has QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080", while shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 2026-11-16T15:07:26Z, replicas 1, ready 1) has QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" — i.e. the env value changed in the pod template with an unchanged image reference.

Kubernetes events for the shipping rollout: "Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1" and "Created pod: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn" at 15:07:26, "Started container shipping" at 15:07:33, then "Killing"/"Deleted pod: shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q" and "Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0" at 15:07:33.

Pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running and ready on node i-00d608019e1b5d480 with 0 restarts and no previous container instance; the 60 newest of 339 log lines read from it between 15:07:26 and 15:16:27 are repeated "Requesting quote" entries with no explicit error text in the returned lines.

Sampled shipping error traces at 15:18:04-15:18:06 reproduce the same error detail: shipping "/get-quote" spans carry otel.status_description "Internal Server Error" and their child shipping "POST " spans carry "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))"; the same traces carry frontend 500 spans and checkout grpc.status_code 13 spans with the shipping quote failure message.

For service email the 14m window ending 15:18:46 returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series ("POST /send_order_confirmation" 87.11, "send_email" 87.11, "sinatra.render_template" 174.22) and a trace search for email error=true in 15:17:00-15:18:30 returned no traces; no email error status was observed, but absence in the returned series/sample is not a proven zero.

For service quote the same query returned only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series, with the 14m span increase falling from 1524.44 (window ending 15:04:46) to 261.33 (window ending 15:18:46), consistent with shipping's requests no longer arriving after the 15:07 rollout; the trace above contains no quote span.

Primary hypothesis: the 15:07:26 shipping rollout carried a malformed QUOTE_ADDR ("quote:0000" vs the previous "http://quote:8080"), so shipping cannot construct the URI for its outbound quote POST (InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)), /get-quote returns 500, checkout PlaceOrder fails with gRPC 13, frontend POST /api/checkout returns 500, and frontend's request error rate exceeds the alert threshold; the timing (pod started 15:07:33, alert at 15:08:46) and the zero-error baseline before the rollout support this over other causes.

Rejected: a defect inside the frontend service itself. Frontend's only error spans are on the checkout path, every other frontend operation has 0 error spans in the window, its own exception/grpc error text relays the checkout failure, and the deepest failing span in the trace belongs to shipping.

Rejected: checkout as the origin. In trace 3767891927621b4297f49efad5961ac3 checkout's cart, currency and product-catalog calls all return rpc.grpc.status_code "0", and checkout's only failing child span is the HTTP POST to shipping, whose /get-quote span fails with "Internal Server Error" and whose child POST span fails with InvalidUri(InvalidFormat).

Unresolved alternative: the error text relayed by checkout and frontend names the "email service" ("failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"). However the only failing shipping outbound span is a URI-format error raised before any request is sent, that trace contains no quote or email span, and no email error-status series was returned, so an email-service 500 is not corroborated and remains unconfirmed rather than the supported cause.

Restore the shipping Deployment pod template env QUOTE_ADDR to the previously working value "http://quote:8080" (port 8080 on service quote) and roll the Deployment, then confirm shipping "/get-quote" error spans and frontend "POST /api/checkout" 500s return to the pre-15:07 zero baseline.

Human follow-up: use change history / Deployment revision history to identify who or what changed shipping's QUOTE_ADDR at 15:07:26 and add validation (or a pre-rollout smoke test of /get-quote) so that a malformed endpoint value cannot be rolled out.

gaps: change_history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so who/what modified the shipping Deployment env at 15:07:26 and whether the change was intentional could not be established.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (status no_data, empty result), so the alert's exact expression/threshold and its evaluation at the incident time could not be verified; only the alert annotation value (1.7778) is known.

The previous shipping container's logs and the replaced pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q are gone, so whether the old pod logged errors or which URL it used cannot be observed directly; the old ReplicaSet template is the only evidence of its QUOTE_ADDR.

No container log line containing the InvalidUri/quote failure was observed in the 339 lines read from shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (all returned lines are "Requesting quote"), so the exact raised error is known only from span tags.

Whether email service returned any 5xx during the window is unknown: no ERROR-status span series for email was returned and the email error trace search returned no traces, which is absence of evidence, not a measured zero.
The trace view is a sampled projection (traces_search), so the listed spans describe those traces only and not a complete call graph or failure rate.

Background event-stream error spans exist for ad, fraud-detection and recommendation flagd operations (around 1-2 per 14m) both before and after the change; they were not investigated further and are not tied to this alert by the evidence.
next_steps: Inspect Deployment shipping revision history / audit log for the 15:07:26 env change to QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" and its author or automation.
Restore QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 on Deployment otel-demo/shipping and verify shipping /get-quote and frontend POST /api/checkout error spans fall back to zero.
Add a post-rollout smoke check of shipping's quote dependency and validation of service-address env values before rollout.

If the email-service mention in the error text matters, collect shipping application logs at debug level and email service request metrics for the incident window to confirm whether any 5xx was returned by email.
